rationale: Run mcp-diagnostic-runtime-reliability-20261027-01, approved SDD-016 and T-022. One generated worker-only Node bundle of the same full Core factory reduces repeated module initialization; actual protocol/schema/error/resource/read-state modules stay shared and original module URLs are preserved. Root build tooling reuses the already UI-locked Rolldown 1.2.12; no compiler is shipped or run by MCP. New declared worker entry is freshly hashed; server import-map compatibility rejects an older same-version dispatcher before public admission. Prior wire digests remain version-selected. Selected-file hashing sorts paths before reading and immediately consumes each fresh file instead of retaining every SDK buffer; the historical wire digest and full selected byte set remain identical. Exact Copilot payload 419 files/4449075 bytes (+1 file/+741038 over 418/3708037), no spare headroom. Private balanced probe measured about27% lower call latency and45% lower startup CPU; this is not final acceptance or host qualification. Hard request/result/worker/UI/timing limits unchanged. Approved SDD-019/020 and T-025 through T-028 add the SDK-free shared owner protocol, explicit process/thread compositions and the detached owner channel. Genuine facade/generation Workers retain existing publication, Core and request-worker ownership. The entry-owned SDK wire serializes one write with a bounded queue; valid result/UI payload limits remain unchanged. Fixed owner framing is budgeted separately so complete legacy 64 KiB/1 MiB packets still fit. Fresh synchronous claims precede executable creation; the freshly inspected serving producer binds to its expected identity before SDK service. Exact late replies settle protected pending requests; timeout alone cannot release them. No parallel domain factory, runtime compiler or SDK pruning is introduced. Exact observed Copilot payload: 428 files/4480880 bytes (+9 files/+31805 over 419/4449075), no spare allowance. Targeted scripted evidence remains distinct from final performance, installed host and other-platform qualification. T-014 actual native discovery exposed missing compact OR template/format under the unchanged Quick Task Execution gate. T-011/SDD-011 and the SDD-020 exact measured payload policy bind the existing closeout owner and expose its mandatory Run/Report mode metadata and four sections; the validator remains unchanged in effect. Reviewed delta is exactly 1831 bytes across four existing Core modules and the generated full-factory Worker, no added or omitted files. Exact current baseline: 428 files/4482711 bytes, zero spare allowance. Hard request/result/definition/material/worker/UI/timing limits remain unchanged; installed 85320f41dcc0 is still the observed native candidate until separate concrete replacement authority. PR #42 integrates main356cc4ee including canonical run-closure and Git identity owners, target-scoped closure schema/receipt guards and current companion/control contracts.
